pages.text: A bow that launches compatible weapons, such as swords, instead of arrows.$(br2)Carry a compatible weapon, hold use to draw, then release to fire. The launched weapon leaves your inventory.$(br2)Check JEI for its crafting recipe.

pages.title: Loading and Recovery
pages.text: Weapons in the main inventory are selected before those in the hotbar. Check the bow's tooltip to see which weapon will be loaded.$(br2)Loyalty on the bow returns the weapon after impact. Without Loyalty, collect the dropped weapon. Infinity is not supported.
